scene: 朱江在办公室收到黑金邀请函
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style with strong light-shadow contrast, saturated colors, hard ink lines. A young Chinese man in his late 20s (based on reference photo) sits at a modern startup office desk at night, holding a matte black card with gold text. Dramatic warm desk lamp lighting from the left. Expression: curious and intrigued. Medium close-up shot from slightly above. Modern tech office background with monitors showing code. Bright warm lighting.
text:
深夜十一点半，我正在改第三版融资PPT。

一张黑金卡片，不知道什么时候滑进了门缝下面。上面只印了一行字：「你的公司值多少？来证明。」

我翻过来，背面是一个地址和时间——今晚，凌晨一点，金茂大厦顶层。

scene: 朱江到达豪华会所门口
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. A young Chinese man (reference photo) in a casual blazer over dark t-shirt, standing before massive gold-trimmed doors of a penthouse private club. Low angle shot looking up, emphasizing the grandeur. Warm golden light spilling from the crack of the opening door. Night cityscape visible through floor-to-ceiling windows behind. Expression: calm confidence with a hint of tension. Full body shot.
text:
金茂顶层，六十八楼。

电梯门打开的瞬间，我闻到了雪茄和单麦威士忌的味道。

「朱先生，请。」穿黑西装的男人微微欠身。

我整了整衣领。创业三年，我见过各种局，但这种级别的——还是头一回。

scene: 赌桌全景，四位对手亮相
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style, dramatic lighting. Bird's eye view of an elegant round poker table with green felt, gold chip stacks, and five leather chairs. Four opponents already seated: a cold-faced man in expensive suit (big tech exec), a smiling middle-aged man (investor), a young arrogant man (rival CEO), and a mysterious elegant woman in black. The fifth chair is empty, spotlit. Crystal chandelier above casting warm golden light. Luxurious penthouse interior.
text:
圆桌上已经坐了四个人。

冷面男——某大厂AI负责人，手指有节奏地敲着桌面，像在审批OKR。

笑面虎——圈内最有名的投资人之一，笑容堆到眼角褶子里，看谁都像在估值。

愣头青——竞品公司CEO，比我小两岁，但烧钱速度比我快十倍。

还有一个沉默的女人，黑色西装，表情像一面镜子——什么都不露。

我坐下。这不是赌局，这是商战的缩影。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Close-up of a luxurious leather-bound menu showing poker stakes list in Chinese characters: A100算力卡, 千万级数据集, 独家API接口, 收购要约. Gold embossed text on dark leather. A man's hand (slightly visible at edge) holding the menu. Warm amber lighting from above. Shallow depth of field.
text:
荷官递来赌注清单，我差点没端住。

一张A100算力卡 = 一百万美金筹码。千万级数据集、独家API接口、甚至——收购要约。

我心里默算了一下公司账上的现金，嗯……大概够买两杯桌上的酒。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style, dramatic close-up. A young Chinese man's hands (reference photo visible from chin down) picking up gold and black poker chips from the table. Intense warm spotlight on the hands and chips. Green felt table surface. Expression visible in lower face: slight smirk of determination. Extreme close-up shot.
text:
但创业者最不缺的就是——拿别人的钱赌自己的命。

我拿起筹码，感受了一下重量。

「开始吧。」

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the young Chinese man (reference photo, back of head visible), looking across the poker table at the four opponents. The investor is smiling broadly pushing chips forward. The big tech exec stares at his cards expressionlessly. Warm golden chandelier light. Dramatic shadows on faces. Focus on reading micro-expressions.
text:
第一局，我没急着出手。

创业教会我一件事——进入新市场，先观察，别急着烧钱。

冷面男每次下注前都要看三遍牌，像他们公司立项要过三轮评审。

投资人出手极快，一局能加注四次——跟他们投项目一样，赌的就是概率。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Medium close-up of the young Chinese man (reference photo) looking at his poker cards with a thoughtful expression. Cards slightly visible. The investor's hand pushing a large stack of gold chips is visible across the table (blurred foreground). Dramatic side lighting creating half-shadow on face. Interior tension moment.
text:
[决策时刻]

我拿到一对Q。不算差，但也不算好。

投资人直接加注五十万——还没看清局势就梭了？

我脑子里两个声音打架：一个说「信息不够，弃牌」，另一个说「你是来打牌的，不是来看的」。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Dynamic medium shot of the young Chinese man (reference photo) calmly pushing a stack of chips forward with one hand, other hand resting on the table. Confident half-smile. Warm golden light. The other players watch with varying expressions (visible in background). Slight low angle to show confidence.
text:
我推出筹码：「跟。」

不是冲动。花小钱买信息，是做AI的人最懂的事——先拿到数据，再训练模型。

投资人的笑容微微僵了零点三秒。

够了。这零点三秒值五十万。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Close-up of a smartphone screen showing a WeChat message: '老板你在哪？服务器又挂了！！！' with panicked emojis. The phone is being held below the poker table by the young Chinese man's hand. Blurred poker table above. Warm ambient light. Comedic contrast between high-stakes poker and startup chaos.
text:
裤兜里手机震了一下。

CTO发来消息：「老板你在哪？服务器又挂了！！！」

我单手在桌下打字：「你先重启。我在处理一个……更复杂的分布式系统。」

「什么系统？」

「人性。」

「？？？」

scene: 朱江观察到投资人和竞品CEO交换眼神
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. The young Chinese man (reference photo) in profile, eyes narrowed, noticing something. In the background (slightly out of focus), the smiling investor and the young rival CEO exchange a subtle glance. Dramatic spotlight creating strong shadows. Tension building. The mysterious woman also watching from the far side. Warm golden ambient light.
text:
第三局结束，我输了一小笔。

但我注意到一个细节——

投资人加注的时候，愣头青的右手食指会轻轻敲两下桌面。而投资人弃牌的时候，愣头青会摸一下鼻子。

巧合？我不信巧合。

做AI的人都知道：一次是噪音，两次是信号，三次是特征。

scene: 竞品CEO赢走朱江重要筹码
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. The young arrogant rival CEO triumphantly pulling a large pile of gold chips towards himself, smirking. The young Chinese man (reference photo) visible across the table, face calm but jaw slightly tightened. Other players watching. Warm golden light with dramatic shadows. Medium wide shot of the table.
text:
第五局，愣头青亮了一把顺子，赢走了我一个千万级数据集的筹码。

他笑着说：「朱总，你家模型训练不是缺数据吗？可惜了。」

我面不改色。

因为我已经确认了——他们是一伙的。暗号系统，至少有六种信号组合。

scene: [DECISION-2] 朱江发现作弊后的内心挣扎
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Extreme close-up of the young Chinese man's face (reference photo), half in shadow half in warm light. Eyes sharp and calculating. A subtle reflection of poker chips visible in his eyes. The most dramatic lighting of the sequence - strong contrast between light and dark halves of face. Internal struggle visible in expression.
text:
[决策时刻]

我可以现在翻桌。

证据？我脑子里已经记录了十七组信号——足够了。

但如果我现在揭穿，两个人联手针对我，这局没法打了。

菩萨心肠，霹雳手段。

——我不是不揭穿你。我是要让你输得更彻底。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. The young Chinese man (reference photo) leaning back in his chair with a seemingly frustrated sigh, one hand rubbing his temple. But his eyes (partially hidden by his hand) are sharp and alert - a subtle detail showing his act. Chips being pushed away. The investor and rival CEO exchanging satisfied looks in background. Warm ambient lighting.
text:
接下来三局，我「连输三把」。

投资人和愣头青越来越放松，暗号越来越明显——人在得意的时候，最容易犯错。

冷面男看了我一眼，目光里有一丝……同情？

同情就对了。我需要所有人以为我快完了。

scene: 朱江在纸巾上记录暗号系统
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Bird's eye close-up of a cocktail napkin on the table edge, with subtle marks/dots drawn by a pen (the signal decoding notes). The young Chinese man's hand holding a pen near it, disguised as fidgeting. A whiskey glass nearby. Warm amber light. Spy thriller feeling - secret intelligence gathering at the poker table.
text:
我借着擦手的动作，在餐巾纸上记下了他们的暗号体系：

敲两下 = 我有大牌，配合加注。
摸鼻子 = 弃牌信号。
左手托腮 = 换我来做庄家牌。

六种信号，全部破解。

该反击了。

scene: 朱江眼神变化——猎人就位
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Dramatic low angle shot of the young Chinese man (reference photo) straightening up in his chair, adjusting his blazer sleeve. Eyes now sharp like a predator. Warm spotlight from above creating a crown of light. The poker table and opponents below in slightly darker tones. Power shift moment. Dynamic manga-style impact feeling.
text:
我直起身子，整了整袖口。

之前的朱江是猎物。

现在？

猎人就位。

scene: 朱江反向利用暗号系统赢回筹码
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Dynamic shot of the young Chinese man (reference photo) confidently flipping his cards, revealing a winning hand. Gold chips scattered in motion towards him. The rival CEO's face shows shock in the background. Dramatic warm lighting with motion blur on flying chips. Energy and momentum in the composition.
text:
第九局。

愣头青敲了两下桌面——他有大牌，要投资人配合加注。

我微笑着跟注。因为我知道他有大牌，我的牌更大。

翻牌的时候，愣头青脸上的表情——值一千万。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Montage composition: multiple overlapping panels showing the young Chinese man (reference photo) winning hand after hand. Chips piling up. Opponents' expressions shifting from confident to worried. Dynamic diagonal composition with speed lines. Warm golden tones with red accent highlights. Comic book montage energy.
text:
第十局，赢。第十一局，赢。第十二局——我故意输了一小把，免得他们太早醒悟。

第十三局，又赢。

投资人终于笑不出来了。愣头青开始冒汗。

我心里默念：这叫——过拟合陷阱。你们训练数据太少，泛化能力不够。

scene: [DECISION-3] 沉默女性递来合作提议
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. The mysterious elegant woman in black leaning forward across the poker table, sliding a small card towards the young Chinese man (reference photo). Her expression is intense but respectful. Dramatic side lighting on both faces. Intimate negotiation moment within the larger poker game. Warm amber tones.
text:
[决策时刻]

沉默女人开口了——整晚第一次说话。

「朱先生，你的AI模型，API独家授权给我的公司。作为交换——我帮你清理这两个作弊的。」

条件很诱人。但「独家授权」这四个字——

创业者有一条铁律：永远不把核心能力独家给任何人。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Medium shot of the young Chinese man (reference photo) holding up two fingers, speaking with calm confidence. The mysterious woman listens intently across the table. Warm golden spotlight between them. Business negotiation energy - two equals bargaining. Professional and strategic atmosphere.
text:
「不做独家。」我说。

她眼神微冷。

「但我可以给你非独家授权，外加利润分成。你赚到的，我抽两成。」

她沉默了三秒。

「成交。」

我不卖灵魂。但我可以分享利润。——这是创业三年交的最贵的学费教会我的。

scene: [DECISION-4] 关键一局，朱江要不要让竞品CEO破产
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Split composition: top half shows the young Chinese man (reference photo) holding clearly winning cards with a conflicted expression. Bottom half shows the rival CEO across the table, sweat on his forehead, last chips pushed all-in. Dramatic warm spotlight creating a moral dilemma atmosphere. Emotional weight in the scene.
text:
[决策时刻]

第十五局。我手里的牌能让愣头青直接清零——他押上了最后的筹码。

赢了，他的公司估计撑不过下个月。

我想起他去年在行业大会上跟我打招呼的样子，眼睛里全是野心和天真——像三年前的我。

算了。赢归赢，别赶尽杀绝。

scene: 朱江赢牌后归还一枚筹码
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. The young Chinese man (reference photo) reaching across the table, pushing a single chip back towards the defeated rival CEO. A warm, almost kind expression on his face. The rival CEO looks up in shock and confusion. Warm golden light softening the scene. A moment of mercy in a ruthless game. Medium shot.
text:
我亮牌，赢走了核心资源。

然后——我把他那张算力卡推了回去。

「还你。你会需要的。」

愣头青愣住了：「为什么？」

「因为我妈说做人要留一线。」我笑了笑，「而且主要是怕你以后报复我。」

——菩萨心肠。但核心利益，一分不让。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Humorous shot of the young Chinese man (reference photo) glancing down at his phone under the table with an exasperated but amused expression. Phone screen shows multiple panicked messages from CTO. Other players waiting for the next hand above. Warm ambient light. Comedy beat breaking the tension.
text:
手机又震了。

CTO：「修好了！原因找到了，有人把测试环境的配置推到了生产。」
CTO：「等等老板你到底在干嘛？？」
CTO：「你是不是去打麻将了？？」

我：「德扑。」

CTO：「……」
CTO：「赢了吗？」

我：「目前看，ROI比咱们上轮融资高。」

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Dramatic wide shot of only two players remaining at the table: the young Chinese man (reference photo) and the investor facing each other. Massive chip stacks between them. Empty chairs of eliminated players. Dramatic overhead warm spotlight creating a spotlight arena effect. Final showdown atmosphere. Low angle emphasizing the epic scale.
text:
牌桌上只剩两个人。我，和投资人。

赌注？我公司的领投权。

如果我赢——我掌握融资主动权。如果我输——他进我的董事会，带着否决权。

荷官发牌。我看了一眼。

我的心跳慢了半拍——不是紧张，是兴奋。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Intense close-up of the investor leaning forward menacingly, finger pointing, his fake smile finally cracked showing cold calculation. The young Chinese man (reference photo) visible in the background, sitting straight, unmoved. Dramatic warm/cool contrast lighting - warm on the protagonist, cooler on the investor. Confrontation energy.
text:
[决策时刻]

翻牌前，投资人放下牌，盯着我：

「小朱，你赢了牌局也没用。我一个电话，整个一级市场没人敢投你。」

空气冷了两度。

旁边看牌的冷面男轻轻叹了口气。沉默女人端起酒杯，遮住了嘴角。

他在等我怕。

scene: 朱江站起来亮牌——全篇最燃
prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. MOST DRAMATIC FRAME. The young Chinese man (reference photo) rising from his chair, slamming his winning cards face-up on the table. Low angle hero shot looking up at him. Blazer jacket fluttering slightly from the motion. Expression: fierce confidence, zero fear. Chips scattered from the impact. Dramatic warm golden backlight creating a halo effect. Maximum visual impact. Power pose.
text:
我站了起来。

把牌翻开，拍在桌上。

「我的DAU是你投的项目的十倍。不是我需要你——」

我看着他愣住的表情。

「——是你错过了我。」

然后我转向沉默女人：「合作的事，明天正式聊。」

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. The mysterious woman standing, removing a thin card from her jacket pocket - a prestigious fund's business card. She looks at the young Chinese man (reference photo) with respect and a test-giver's satisfaction. Warm golden light. Other players in background showing surprise. Revelation moment - the puppet master revealed.
text:
[决策时刻]

沉默女人忽然鼓了两下掌。

「朱先生，这场牌局——是我设计的。一场压力测试。」

她递过一张名片。某顶级基金LP。管理规模——我多看了两遍，确认没多数零。

「你通过了。但我有一个条件——公司必须承诺，永远不做军事AI。」

我看着她的眼睛。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Medium close-up of the young Chinese man (reference photo) speaking with absolute conviction, one hand over his heart. The woman listens with a slight approving nod. Warm, almost golden-hour quality light. Sincerity radiating from the frame. An intimate, honest moment between two people who share values.
text:
「这不是你的条件。」我说。

她挑了挑眉。

「这是我自己的底线。」

我想起创业第一天写在白板上的那句话：构建人与AI和谐共生的新文明时代。

「人和AI应该互相成就，不是互相伤害。这件事——我不需要任何人来要求我。」

她笑了。整晚第一个真笑。

「所以你确实通过了。」

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. The young Chinese man (reference photo) walking out of a building entrance into the pre-dawn city. City lights twinkling in the background - Shanghai skyline at 3:30 AM. He's looking at his phone with a relaxed smile. Cool blue pre-dawn sky contrasting with warm streetlights. Full body shot from behind at slight angle, looking over his shoulder at the phone. Peaceful after the storm.
text:
凌晨三点半。

上海的夜灯还没灭，天边已经有了一点点亮。

CTO发来消息：「老板服务器彻底稳了。你到底去哪了？？？」

我：「去上了一堂商学院没教的课。」

手机弹出一条推送：「某基金宣布领投一家AI创业公司，估值翻三倍。」

我笑着收起手机，打开笔记本电脑。

凌晨三点半，最适合写代码。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. A smartphone screen showing a WeChat Moments post from the rival CEO: the post has a sad emoji and Chinese text about losing but learning a lesson. Below are several likes and comments. The phone is held by the young Chinese man's hand (reference photo hand visible). Warm cozy lighting suggesting he's at his desk. Humorous ending beat.
text:
临走前我刷了一眼朋友圈。

愣头青发了一条：「今晚亏了一个亿，但学到了一件事：永远不要和创业者赌。他们早就押上了全部。」

底下评论区：

冷面男：「同意。」
投资人：「……」

我默默点了个赞。

prompt: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Hong Kong manhua realistic style. Final wide shot: the young Chinese man (reference photo) sitting at a small desk by a floor-to-ceiling window, laptop open, typing. Pre-dawn Shanghai skyline panorama behind the glass - city lights transitioning to early morning blue. His reflection faintly visible in the glass. Peaceful, determined, looking forward. Warm desk lamp contrasting with cool dawn light. Cinematic ending frame.
text:
有人问我：你不怕吗？

创业者哪有不怕的。

但怕和退，是两回事。

赌桌上最大的筹码，从来不是钱。

是你愿不愿意——把自己全押上去。

[完]
